header: The software is free. Services are optional.
subheadline: Four ways to work with us, from the free licence to hosting and a monthly retainer.

items.title: Licences
items.description: Community is free under GPL-2.0-or-later. Pro (€49/month) and Agency (€149/month) add priority support and early access. Paying yearly saves 2 months.

items.title: Setup and adaptation
items.description: Installation for €890, a theme preset in your brand from €1,990 and custom elements from €390. The maintainers do the work.

items.title: Hosting
items.description: Managed TYPO3 hosting with updates, daily backups and monitoring in an EU data centre. Business at €179/month adds staging, a 99.9% SLA and a CDN.

items.title: Care retainer
items.description: Creator Care gives you 4 dev hours a month, priority fixes, security monitoring and LTS upgrade planning from the maintainers.
